DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書のご相談ですね。提出先からの案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a certificate, correct? Do you have the instructions from the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい勤務先へ住民票を出すように言われました。家族も一緒に住んでいますが、全員分が必要か書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先要求の世帯範囲不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My new workplace told me to submit a residence certificate. My family lives with me too, but it doesn't say whether everyone's details are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the workplace's required household coverage is unclear. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記載する範囲は提出先の指定をご確認ください。ご本人分と世帯全員分を同じものとして申し込まないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the required coverage with the recipient. Don't apply as though a certificate for yourself and one for the entire household were the same thing.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社に聞いてみます。個人番号を載せるかどうかも、勝手に選ばないほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個人番号記載も提出先へ確認する方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll ask the company. I shouldn't choose on my own whether to include my Individual Number either, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will check with the recipient about including your Individual Number too. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。必要な記載事項を確認してから申請すると、不要な情報を出さずに済みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. Confirming the required entries before applying helps you avoid disclosing unnecessary information.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当者から返事が来ました。本人だけで、個人番号は不要だそうです。ほかの項目はわからないので、案内の文面を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人のみと番号不要の回答と残る不明項目を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The person responsible has replied. They say just myself, with no Individual Number. I don't understand the other items, so could you look at the wording of the instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the reply requiring only yourself and no number, and explain the remaining unclear items. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 文面を確認し、申請書の選択項目をご説明します。不明な指定は、こちらで会社の代わりに決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the wording and explain the selectable application items. We can't decide unclear requirements here on the company's behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、不明な項目はもう一度会社へ聞きます。今日は案内をメモし、本人確認に使える持ち物も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明項目の再照会と本人確認資料を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll ask the company again about the unclear items. Today I'd like to note the guidance and check what I can bring as identification too.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will inquire again about unclear items and ask about identification documents. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付担当が必要な持ち物をご説明します。確認が済んだら、申請時に同じ案内をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The reception staff will explain what to bring. Once you've checked, show the same instructions when applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記載内容を確定させてから申し込みます。全員分を念のため出すことはしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記載指定確定後に必要範囲で申請すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll apply after finalizing the required contents. I won't provide everyone's details just in case.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to apply only for the required coverage after confirming the entries. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な範囲が整理できましたね。受付で持ち物をご確認ください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've clarified the required scope. Please check what to bring at reception. Off you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便についてのご相談を伺います。いつから新しい住所にお住まいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll hear your inquiry about mail after moving. When will you start living at the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週からです。旧住所へ届く郵便を転送してほしいのですが、市の転出手続きとは別に申し込むのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居予定と市手続きとの違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: From next week. I'd like mail sent to my old address forwarded. Do I apply separately from the city's moving-out procedure?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your planned move and ask how this differs from city procedures. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 郵便の転送は別の手続きとして確認してください。こちらの案内で、対象と申込み方法を見ていきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check mail forwarding as a separate procedure. Let's look at the coverage and application method in this guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族も同時に引っ越します。私だけの名前で出すと、家族の郵便も全部届くようになるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族分の転送対象を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My family is moving at the same time. If I apply only in my name, will all my family's mail arrive too?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check who in your family is covered by forwarding. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その点は申込みの対象者を確認する必要があります。家族分も当然に含まれると考えず、記入方法をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check the people covered by the application. Don't assume your family is automatically included; check how to fill it out.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前を一人ずつ整理します。新住所はマンションで、建物名と部屋番号まで書いたほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全員の名前と建物部屋番号の記入を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll organize each person's name. The new address is an apartment, so I should include the building name and room number too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Organize everyone's names and the building name and room number to enter. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 郵便を届ける住所が特定できるよう確認してください。部屋番号が未確定なら、推測で記入しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ensure the delivery address can be identified. If the room number is undecided, don't guess when filling it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 部屋は四〇二号室と契約書で確認しました。転送だけで、銀行や保険会社の登録住所も変わるわけではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 部屋番号を契約書で確認し送付元登録の扱いを問う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've checked the contract: the room is 402. Forwarding alone doesn't change the address registered with the bank or insurance company, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the room number from the contract and ask about addresses registered with senders. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。各送付元への住所変更は、ご自身で別にご確認ください。転送の対象や開始に関する案内もお読みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Please check address changes with each sender separately yourself. Also read the information on forwarding coverage and when it begins.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族の名前と四〇二号室を正確に記し、銀行などにも連絡します。開始日は案内で確認してから申込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正確な対象住所と送付元連絡と開始確認を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll accurately enter my family's names and room 402 and contact the bank and others too. I'll check the start date in the guide before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to enter the exact people and address, contact senders, and check the start date. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内で不明な点があればお尋ねください。新生活のご準備、お気をつけて。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please ask about anything unclear in the guide. Take care while preparing for your new life. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の変更をご希望ですね。現在届いている通知についてもご相談がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to change your address. Do you also have a question about a notice you're currently receiving?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越したので郵便の転送を申し込みました。それで銀行の登録も変わったと思っていましたが、通知には旧住所が印刷されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転送申込みと旧住所通知の矛盾を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I moved and applied for mail forwarding. I thought that changed the bank's registration too, but the notice has my old address printed on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the mismatch between your forwarding application and the old address on the notice. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 郵便の転送と銀行の登録変更は別です。まず口座の登録情報を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Mail forwarding and changing the bank's registration are separate. The staff member will first check the account's registered information.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 登録変更をお願いします。住所のわかる身分証は更新しましたが、通知の送付先だけ別にできるのかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 銀行の住所変更と別送付先の可否を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please change the registration. I've updated my identification showing my address, but I'd also like to know whether only the mailing destination for notices can be different.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request the bank address change and ask whether a separate mailing address is possible. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送付先の扱いは口座や通知の種類に応じて確認します。ご希望の事情を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check mailing-address handling according to the account and notice type. Please explain your circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出張が多いので実家へ送る案を考えています。ただ、本人が住む住所とは違うので、できると決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出張事情と実家が非居住地である点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm often away on business, so I'm considering having them sent to my parents' home. But it's different from where I live, so I haven't assumed it's possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your business trips and that your parents' home is not your residence. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その違いも含めて担当へ伝えます。認められるかどうかの確認前に、申請が済んだとは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the staff member about that difference too. Don't assume the application is complete before it's confirmed permissible.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。まず現住所を変更し、実家への送付は可能かを別に質問します。次の通知に反映される時期も教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現住所変更と別送付先確認と反映時期を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. First I'll change my current address and separately ask whether mail can go to my parents' home. I'd also like to know when the next notice will reflect the changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish changing your current address, checking a separate mailing destination, and the effective timing. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 反映時期も担当からご案内します。すでに発送準備に入った通知があるか、確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain the timing too. We need to check whether any notice is already being prepared for mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今届いた通知は持ち帰り、住所変更の受付結果と送付先の回答をそれぞれメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付結果と送付先回答を別々に記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the notice I've just received home and separately note the address-change acceptance result and the reply about the mailing destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the acceptance result and the mailing-destination reply separately. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 更新済みの身分証を持って担当へお進みください。ご相談を引き継ぎます。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your updated identification to the staff member. I'll pass on your inquiry. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 参拝のご案内をお探しですか。今日はこの学習用の通路に立入制限があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for worship guidance? Access to this learning passage is restricted today.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 工事の囲いがあるので迷いました。参拝できる所と、御朱印について聞く所を別々に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 参拝と御朱印の案内場所を分けて尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The construction barrier confused me. Please tell me separately where I can worship and where to ask about temple stamps.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask separately about worship guidance and the place to ask about temple stamps. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 参拝の案内表示はこちらです。御朱印の受付状況は授与の担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The worship signs are here. Please check with the staff responsible for issuing stamps about whether they are being accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 囲いの外の表示に沿って進みます。塔の近くまで入れない場合、無理に裏へ回らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 囲い外の表示をたどり裏へ入らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll follow the signs outside the barrier. If I can't approach the tower, I won't try to force my way around the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will follow signs outside the barrier and not go around into the back. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。囲いの向こうは見学用の道ではありません。写真を撮る場合も、こちらの通路を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. Beyond the barrier is not a visitor path. Please keep this passage clear even when taking photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 参拝が先なので、写真はあとにします。御朱印帳を持っていますが、今日は受付中か表示を見てから並べばいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 参拝を優先し御朱印受付状況を表示確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Worship comes first, so I'll take photos later. I have my stamp book, but I should check the sign to see whether requests are being accepted today before queuing, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize worship and check the posted stamp acceptance status. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうしてください。受付終了の表示があれば、列があるだけで受け付けてもらえると判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. If the sign says acceptance has ended, don't assume you'll be accepted merely because there is a line.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 終了していたら改めて来ます。預ける場合には、受け取りの案内も担当へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 終了時の再訪と預かり時の受取確認を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it's ended, I'll come back another time. If I leave the book, I'd also like to check the collection instructions with the person responsible.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will return if acceptance has ended and check collection when leaving your book. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付できた場合は、預かりと受け取りを担当の説明に沿って確認してください。私から時間は確約できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your request is accepted, confirm leaving and collecting it according to the staff's explanation. I cannot promise a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、参拝の表示を見て進み、その後で御朱印の受付状況を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参拝後に御朱印状況を確認する順序を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll follow the worship signs first and check stamp acceptance afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check stamp status after worship. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ立入表示にお気をつけて。穏やかにお参りください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch the access restriction signs. Worship peacefully. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 館内の撮影について、お尋ねになりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to ask about photography inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 窓の光がきれいなので撮りたいのですが、静かに座っている方がいます。いま撮ってもよい場所でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 礼拝者がいる区画の撮影可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: The window light is beautiful and I'd like to photograph it, but people are sitting quietly. Is this an area where I may take photos now?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether photography is permitted in a section with worshippers. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用の案内では、いま礼拝中の区画は撮影を控えていただいています。カメラはしまってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Under this learning guide, we ask you to refrain from photography in sections where worship is taking place now. Please put your camera away and continue.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。音を消しても撮らず、礼拝の邪魔にならない所へ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 音に関わらず撮影を控え移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I won't take photos even with the sound off, and I'll move somewhere I won't disturb worship.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will refrain regardless of sound and move elsewhere. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。見学の範囲については、入口の担当にもご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. You can also check the visiting boundaries with the entrance staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、内部の写真はやめます。外観だけを撮る場合も、入口で条件を聞いたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外観撮影条件を入口で確認する必要性を問う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't take interior photos. Even for exterior photos only, should I ask about the conditions at the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether exterior photography conditions should be checked at the entrance. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。出入りする方の通路をふさがない位置や、行事の案内があるかを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Check where you won't block people entering or leaving, and whether there are event instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 階段の前で立ち止まらず、空いた所を探します。知らない方の姿が入った写真を公開するのも避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路確保と他人を公開しない配慮を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't stop in front of the stairs; I'll find a clear space. I'd also like to avoid publishing photos that show people I don't know.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will keep passages clear and avoid publishing other people's images. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮る向きや時機を選んで、周囲の方へご配慮ください。立入を制限した場所へは入らないでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consider others when choosing your angle and timing. Don't enter areas with restricted access.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 条件を入口で確認し、無理なら今日は撮らずに帰ります。静かに見学するだけでも十分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件次第で撮影を断念し静かな見学を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the conditions at the entrance, and if it isn't possible, I'll leave without photos today. Quietly looking around is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose to give up photography depending on the conditions and visit quietly. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご配慮ありがとうございます。どうぞ穏やかな時間をお過ごしください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your consideration. Please enjoy a peaceful time. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 町歩きの計画についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about plans for a town walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週、友人と古い町並みを見に行きたいです。店も見たいのですが、町を歩ける時間と店の営業時間は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 町歩きと店の利用時間の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: Next week I'd like to see the old townscape with a friend. We'd also like to visit shops. Are the hours for walking around town the same as the shops' opening hours?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the difference between town-walking times and shop opening hours. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 町並みを歩くことと、各店に入れる時間は別に確認してください。この案内所で全店の営業を保証することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check walking around the townscape and entering each shop separately. This information center cannot guarantee all shops will be open.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、訪ねたい二軒を決めて、それぞれの案内を調べます。朝早く行くので、開店前かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 訪問候補二軒と早朝到着を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll choose two shops I'd like to visit and check each one's information. We'll arrive early in the morning, so it may be before opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention two candidate shops and early-morning arrival. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 開店前に建物の外観を見る場合も、私有地に入らず、生活されている方へご配慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even when viewing building exteriors before opening, don't enter private land and be considerate of residents.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通りから見るだけにします。金魚の飾りを見つけても、店の入口の物を勝手に動かして写真を撮らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 私有地と展示物を動かさない配慮を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll only look from the street. Even if we spot goldfish decorations, we won't move things at a shop entrance on our own to take photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show consideration by avoiding private land and not moving displayed objects. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうですね。写真や店内見学については、そのお店へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Check with the shop about photography and looking inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 雨の場合に長く滞在できる場所も調べたいです。ここで特定の店の席を予約することはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 雨天滞在場所と予約取扱を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd also like to find somewhere we can stay longer if it rains. Can we reserve seats at a particular shop here?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about rainy-day places to stay and reservation handling. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 当案内所ではその予約は扱っていません。お店の連絡先を確認して、直接お問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: We don't handle those reservations at this center. Check the shop's contact details and inquire directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 店の営業と予約を直接聞きます。友人には、町歩きは予定していますが、入れる店はまだ未確定と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 店へ直接確認し友人へ未確定状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask the shops directly about opening and reservations. I'll tell my friend the town walk is planned, but which shops we can enter is still unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check directly with shops and tell your friend what remains unconfirmed. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのように確認しておくと安心ですね。良い町歩きになりますように。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Checking that way will be reassuring. I hope you have a lovely town walk. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届いた通知について、ご心配な点を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what worries you about the notice you received.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 罰金を払わないと今日中に逮捕されると書かれた紙が届きました。差出人が警察のような名前なので怖くなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 逮捕を迫る通知と恐怖を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a paper saying I'll be arrested today if I don't pay a fine. The sender has a police-like name, so I'm frightened.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the notice threatening arrest and your fear. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、文面と封筒を見せてください。現時点では、本物の通知とも偽物とも断定せず確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: First show me the wording and envelope. At this point we'll check without deciding it's either genuine or fake.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この電話番号へ連絡するよう書いてあります。口座へ送金する前に、こちらへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知の連絡先と未送金を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says to call this phone number. I brought it here before transferring money to the account.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the contact details on the notice and that you haven't sent money. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送金する前に相談されたのですね。確認の担当へ文面を引き継ぎます。相手に連絡したり個人情報を伝えたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: You consulted before sending money. I'll pass the wording to the verification staff. Have you contacted the sender or given personal information?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ何もしていません。ただ、今日という期限があるので、確認を待つ間に遅れてしまうのではと心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未連絡と当日期限への不安を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't done anything yet. But because the deadline is today, I'm worried it will be too late while I wait for verification.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not contacted them and are worried about today's deadline. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記載された期限も含めて担当が確認します。紙の番号だけを使って急いで連絡せず、こちらで確認を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will check the stated deadline too. Don't rush to contact them using only the paper's number; let's proceed with verification here.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒も残しておきます。同じ文面がメールでも来たら、リンクを開かずにそのまま見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒保存とメールリンクを開かない方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep the envelope too. If the same wording arrives by email, I'll show it as it is without opening the link.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will preserve the envelope and not open email links. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 届いた時刻や連絡の有無も記録してください。確認結果を聞く前に、内容が正しかったことにして支払わないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please record the arrival time and whether there has been contact too. Don't pay on the assumption that the contents were correct before hearing the verification result.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知と封筒を出し、未連絡であることを担当にも伝えます。まず確認結果と次の連絡方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料を提出し確認結果と連絡方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll provide the notice and envelope and tell the verification staff I haven't contacted them. First, please tell me the verification result and how the next contact should be made.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit the documents and ask for the verification result and contact method. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認担当へご案内します。落ち着いて、お手元の資料をお持ちください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll guide you to the verification staff. Stay calm and take your documents with you. Off you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 薬剤師への相談をご希望ですね。今日はどのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to consult a pharmacist. What is troubling you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 咳が続いていて、初めて病院へ行こうか迷っています。ここで診察の受付もできると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 続く咳と診察受付への誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've had a persistent cough and am wondering whether to go to a hospital for the first time. I came thinking I could register for a medical consultation here too.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your persistent cough and mistaken belief that medical registration is available here. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここは薬の相談窓口で、病院の診察受付ではありません。咳はいつからで、息苦しさなどはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a medication consultation counter, not hospital reception for examinations. When did the cough start, and do you have shortness of breath or anything similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四日前からです。息苦しさはありませんが、夜に何度も目が覚めます。医師にそのことを伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 咳の期間と夜間症状と息苦しさの有無を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Four days ago. I don't have shortness of breath, but I wake up many times at night. I'd like to tell a doctor about that.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer the cough duration, nighttime symptoms, and whether you have shortness of breath. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経過を医療機関へお伝えください。こちらで診断や受診先の受付確定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the medical institution about that course. We cannot diagnose you or confirm registration at a medical institution here.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。別の店で買った風邪薬を飲んでいます。病院へ行くなら、その箱も持っていったほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他店購入薬と受診時持参を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'm taking cold medicine bought at another store. If I go to the hospital, should I take its box too?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention medicine bought elsewhere and ask about bringing it to the medical visit. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 薬の名称や飲んだ量が確認できるよう、箱や記録をご用意ください。ほかに服用中の薬があれば、それも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Prepare the box and records so the medicine name and amount taken can be checked. If you're taking other medicines, tell them too.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 毎日の薬はありません。風邪薬の箱と飲んだ時間のメモを持ちます。保険の持ち物は病院へ聞けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他服薬なしと箱時刻メモと保険資料照会を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't have daily medication. I'll bring the cold medicine box and a note of when I took it. Should I ask the hospital what insurance-related items to bring?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you take no other medication, will bring the box and timing notes, and ask about checking insurance documents. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受診する医療機関の受付へご確認ください。待つ間に息苦しさなど状態が変わったら、受診を先延ばしにせず相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check with the reception of the medical institution you'll visit. If your condition changes while waiting, such as shortness of breath, seek advice without putting off medical care.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず医療機関に初診の受付を確認し、咳の期間と夜の様子と服薬を伝えます。ここで診察を予約したとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 医療機関へ初診を確認し症状服薬を伝えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I'll check registration for a first visit with a medical institution and explain the cough duration, nighttime symptoms, and medication. I won't assume I've booked a medical examination here.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check first-visit registration with a medical institution and describe symptoms and medication. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受診時に経過を説明できるよう、メモも忘れずに。どうぞお大事になさってください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Don't forget your notes so you can explain the course at your visit. Please take care of yourself. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様用の靴をお探しですね。ご本人は一緒にいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking for children's shoes. Is the child with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は一人です。二十センチを頼まれましたが、同じサイズでも幅が合うか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人不在とサイズ幅の不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm alone today. I was asked for twenty centimeters, but I'm worried the width might not fit even with the same size.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the child is absent and explain concerns about size and width. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 幅の違う商品があります。ご本人に履いていただくのが確かですが、今日は見本を比較しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have products in different widths. Having the child try them is best, but would you like to compare samples today?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 比較したいです。買って帰って合わなかった場合の条件を、支払う前に確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 幅比較と購入前の交換条件確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Before paying, can I check the conditions if I buy them, take them home, and they don't fit?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to compare widths and check exchange conditions before purchase. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この架空の売場の条件表をご覧ください。屋外で使った物と、未使用の物は同じ扱いではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please look at the conditions sheet for this fictional sales department. Items used outdoors and unused items are not treated the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家で試すときも、外で歩かせず、タグを外さずに確認する必要があるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 屋内試着とタグ扱いを具体的に問う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to ask specifically whether, even when trying them at home, the child needs to avoid walking outside and keep the tags on.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask specifically about indoor trying-on and handling tags. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も条件表の記載と照合しましょう。交換を約束できるかは、購入品と状態を確認して判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's compare that with the conditions sheet too. Whether we can promise an exchange depends on checking the purchased item and its condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: やはり今日は買わずに、幅の違う二種類の商品名をメモします。子どもと来れば試着できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入保留と商品メモと本人試着を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: After all, I won't buy today; I'll note the names of two products with different widths. Can the child try them if we come together?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Postpone purchase, note products, and ask about the child trying them on. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 試着のご希望は来店時にお伝えください。サイズの在庫は変わることがあるので、同じ商品が必ずあるとは申し上げられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell us you want to try them on when visiting. Size availability can change, so we cannot say the same products will definitely be here.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 再来店前に在庫を聞き、子どもとサイズを確認します。代理で決めてしまうのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再来店前在庫確認と本人のサイズ選択を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask about stock before returning and check the size with the child. I won't decide on their behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check stock before returning and choose the size with the child present. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品名はこちらです。ご本人と無理なくお選びください。ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the product names. Please choose comfortably together with the child. Thank you. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご到着前の予約確認ですね。予約番号から照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're checking a booking before arrival. I'll match it using your booking number.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一名で予約していますが、友人も泊まりたいと言っています。同じ部屋へ二人で入ってよいか、先に聞きたくて電話しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一名予約へ友人追加の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've booked for one, but a friend says they'd like to stay too. I called to ask beforehand whether two people may use the same room.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a friend can be added to a one-person booking. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一名の予約をそのまま二名で利用できるとは限りません。お部屋の定員と空き状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: A one-person booking cannot necessarily be used unchanged by two people. We'll check the room capacity and availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ友人には泊まれると言っていません。二人分に変更した場合の金額も、決める前に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人への未確約と変更料金確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't told my friend they can stay yet. I'd also like to know the price if changed to two before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not promised your friend and ask about the changed price. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人数変更の可否と追加料金があるか、予約担当からご案内します。ご宿泊日は変更しませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: The booking staff will explain whether the number can change and whether there is an extra charge. Will the stay date remain unchanged?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日は同じです。友人が来られなくなった場合に、変更した人数を戻す条件も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同日宿泊と人数再変更条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: The date is the same. I'd also like to check the conditions for changing the number back if my friend can no longer come.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the same date and ask about conditions for reversing the guest-number change. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その条件も含めて担当へ伝えます。変更が確定するまでは、現在の一名の予約として扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass that on to the staff too. Until a change is confirmed, we'll treat it as the current one-person booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、二名への変更を今すぐ確定せず、案内を聞いてから返事をします。チェックイン時刻は十九時の予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更確定を保留し十九時到着を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't confirm the change to two right now; I'll reply after hearing the guidance. My planned check-in time is seven p.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hold off confirming the change and give your seven-p.m. arrival time. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 到着予定も記録します。変更受付の結果は、担当からの連絡で必ずご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll record your planned arrival too. Please make sure to confirm the change acceptance result through the booking staff's contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十九時到着で一名予約のままと理解しました。可否と金額と人数を戻す条件を聞いてから友人と相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在一名予約と判断前の確認項目を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand it's still a one-person booking with arrival at seven p.m. I'll discuss it with my friend after hearing whether it's possible, the price, and the conditions for changing the number back.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat the current one-person booking and the items to check before deciding. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご相談内容を予約担当へ引き継ぎます。お電話ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass your inquiry to the booking staff. Thank you for calling. Goodbye.
